name: bld6_real_nonneg_poly_root_sq_dvd
statement: (p : Polynomial ℝ) (h : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ Polynomial.eval x p) (a : ℝ) (ha : Polynomial.eval a p = 0) : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ 2 ∣ p
closed: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ) (h : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ Polynomial.eval x p) (a : ℝ) (ha : Polynomial.eval a p = 0), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ 2 ∣ p
informal: Uses Mathlib2.poly_real_nonneg_eq_sum_two_squares: write p = f^2 + g^2; evaluating at a gives f(a)^2 + g(a)^2 = 0, so f(a) = g(a) = 0, hence X - a divides both f and g (Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot) and (X - a)^2 divides f^2 + g^2.
type: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ), (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ Polynomial.eval x p) → ∀ (a : ℝ), Polynomial.eval a p = 0 → (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ 2 ∣ p
